sources.title: GGUF-Models (GGUF) - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Our goal is to simplify the process of searching for and exchanging quantized models in GGUF format, as well as to create a space for efficient exchange and access to the models you need

sources.title: ggml/docs/gguf.md at master · ggml-org/ggml · GitHub
sources.snippet: It is a successor file format to GGML, GGMF and GGJT, and is designed to be unambiguous by containing all the information needed to load a model. It is also designed to be extensible, so that new information can be added to models without breaking compatibility. For more information about the motivation behind GGUF, see Historical State of Affairs.
